subject: Square root of GMRF'S Q matrix

messages.author: 56168e3bb7011f27
messages.subject: Square root of GMRF'S Q matrix
parts:
Hi,

is there currently any function in R-INLA that computes the square root of the precision matrix Q of the solution of the SPDE? I could use other R functions for calculating the square root of matrices but if there's something available within INLA already, I guess it would probably be the fastest solution/function :)

Thank you,
Isa

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Square root of GMRF'S Q matrix
parts:
If you by sqrt you mean

Q=AA

With symmetric A, Like using the sqrt of the eigenvalue and the eigenvector matrix, then no.

If you by sqrt mean

Q=AA’

Then yes, if A is lower-triangular, then this is just the Cholesky factorisation.

H
